title: SREV-015 ALPC connect flags

official_surface_caveat.description: Microsoft Learn does not expose a public NtAlpcConnectPort or ALPC_PORT_ATTRIBUTES.Flags contract; winternl.h internal APIs may change between releases

local_constant_inventory.description: Local headers define PORT_INFO_WOW64_PROCESS=0x40000000, PORT_INFO_CANIMPERSONATE=0x010000, ALPC_SYNC_CONNECTION=0x020000, ALPC_MESSAGE_FLAG_VIEW=0x40000000 citing an ALPC paper not Microsoft DDI

patch_scope.description: Replace naked constants with existing local names where the behavior is identical; do not broaden accepted ALPC flags or change proxy policy without Windows capture evidence

source_comment_contract.description: Source comments identify SREV-015 at the ALPC connection gate and message-view gates, naming them as locally observed private ALPC shapes that require Windows capture before behavior changes

naming_invariant.description: Connect path does not use naked 0x20000, 0x10000, or 0x40000000 for already-named local ALPC meanings

capture_matrix.description: Capture AlpcConnectRequest, AlpcConnectSuccess, and AlpcConnectFail for ntsvcs and plugplay, including connection flags, ALPC_PORT_ATTRIBUTES.Flags, message-view flags, status, process image, endpoint, and Windows build

open_runtime_gate.description: Ledger keeps the issue open for Windows runtime capture rather than pretending the semantics are officially proven

shared_capture_playbook.description: Shared SREV-015/SREV-138 ALPC runtime capture playbook and machine-readable evidence schema define the Windows capture record shape

contracts: ALPC flag semantics in this code are not officially specified by Microsoft Learn
Replace 0x020000 with ALPC_SYNC_CONNECTION and 0x010000 with PORT_INFO_CANIMPERSONATE where behavior is identical
Source comments name SREV-015 and classify ALPC accepted flags and view masks as locally observed private ALPC shapes
Do not invent new flag bits without Windows runtime capture
Proxy policy behavior is unchanged; only constant naming clarifies intent
SREV-138 mirror-header proof is required before interpreting captured ALPC_PORT_ATTRIBUTES or ALPC_MESSAGE_VIEW fields
SREV-015 and SREV-138 share docs/plan/srev-015-138-alpc-runtime-capture.schema.json as the machine-readable Windows evidence shape

negative_controls: connection flags other than ALPC_SYNC_CONNECTION after WOW64 masking
non-null connection info on ALPC path
unknown ALPC_MESSAGE_VIEW bits outside accepted mask
missing SendView outside unmap special case
missing ReceiveView outside unmap special case
missing receive-size pointer outside unmap special case
non-ntsvcs non-plugplay endpoint preserves native behavior
